shared_elements: shallow incised/pecked linear marks on a natural rock surface
curved or circular motif (possible spiral/concentric ring in A; small discs and circles within the ship in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear schematic, linear pecked marks including curved/circular forms, which is about as generic as rock-art content gets. B presents a dense figural narrative scene — multiple crewed boats with stroke-crew, quadrupeds, a human figure with raised arms, and a large ladder/grid structure — whereas A shows only a single ambiguous curvilinear motif with no figures, no repetition and no discernible composition to compare.
